spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Golden late afternoon on the Yonghe riverside bike path along a low levee by the wide Xindian River: the man pedals a bicycle and the woman sits sideways on the rear rack with one hand on his waist, her hair blowing in the wind; tall grass sways in the foreground; across the river the Taipei skyline with Taipei 101 small in the distance. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
